newsitem.title: INDIA: Good demand for all grades at Calcutta tea auction.
newsitem.headline: Good demand for all grades at Calcutta tea auction.

text.p: All grades attracted brisk demand at this week's Calcutta tea sale, traders said on Friday.
A total of 1.12 million kg, including 147,482 kg of Darjeeling, was on offer.
Among CTC varieties, Assam and Doors were dearer.
Major blends were active, while liquoring fanning grades attracted some export interest, brokers said.
Among orthodox teas, whole leaf grades, medium brokens and fannings were dearer.
There was good demand from the Middle East and the Commonwealth of Independent States, they added.
